metadata.description: An integration skill for adding Needlepath to an application, and a Claude Code plugin that applies Needlepath to large tool results.

plugins.name: needlepath-integration
plugins.description: Wire Needlepath into an application, agent, RAG pipeline or model gateway, with a pinned operating point, shadow-first rollout and exact fail-open behaviour.

plugins.name: needlepath
plugins.description: Sends large tool results through Needlepath context selection so Claude reads excerpts of the original text instead of all of it, never a rewrite. Fails open: on any problem Claude keeps the original output.
